decontamination_notes: Real filename-spoofing hardening from jshttp/content-disposition PR #138 ('Reject invalid percent-encoding in ISO-8859-1 ext-value'), merged 2026-08-03 -- after the training cutoffs of the models evaluated here (e.g. Opus 5, May 2026), so the specific fix is not in their training data (decontaminated: true), with upstream_merged recorded as proof. RFC 5987 `filename*` ext-values in the ISO-8859-1 charset were decoded leniently: a malformed percent-escape (e.g. %2r, %GG, a trailing %) was partially decoded into a `filename` parameter, unlike the UTF-8 path which rejects them. The half-decoded, attacker-influenced filename disagrees with the raw header (filename-spoofing). The fix makes decodeHexEscapes (src/index.ts) return undefined on any malformed escape, so parse() keeps only the raw `filename*` (and falls back to an explicit `filename` when present). content-disposition is a zero-runtime-dependency TypeScript package; hidden tests run via tsx (node-ts image) and import the public parse(). Repo sliced at the PR base commit (src/ tree, 2.3k LOC; decodeHexEscapes still decoding leniently); MIT LICENSE preserved. Coverage floor: 3 fail_to_pass (a malformed %2r escape yields no decoded filename; a malformed filename* falls back to the explicit filename 'invoice.pdf'; invalid hex %GG yields no decoded filename) plus a 2-check regression guard (a valid UTF-8 ext-value still decodes to '€ rates.pdf'; a plain quoted filename is unchanged).

fail_to_pass.name: malformed_no_filename
fail_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb malformed iso-8859-1 escape does not yield a decoded filename$' vb_extvalue.test.ts

fail_to_pass.name: fallback_to_filename
fail_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb malformed filename\* falls back to the explicit filename$' vb_extvalue.test.ts

fail_to_pass.name: invalid_hex_no_filename
fail_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb invalid hex digits do not yield a decoded filename$' vb_extvalue.test.ts

pass_to_pass.name: valid_utf8_decodes
pass_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb valid utf-8 ext-value still decodes$' vb_regression.test.ts

pass_to_pass.name: plain_filename
pass_to_pass.cmd: tsx --test --test-name-pattern='^vb plain quoted filename is unchanged$' vb_regression.test.ts
